emis-unavailable: EMIS is not responding. Please try again later.
emis-paused: EMIS asked us to wait a little. Please try again in a few minutes.
emis-credentials-missing: No working EMIS login is stored for this account. Sign in again to link EMIS.
id-wrong-institution: Only students of International House Tashkent can register.
id-emis-already-linked: This EMIS account already has an IHT account. Log in, reset the password, or reclaim the account with your EMIS credentials.
id-registration-expired: This session has expired. Please start again.
id-email-in-use: This email address is already used by another account.
id-email-not-set: Enter your email address and request a code first.
id-code-invalid: The code is wrong or has expired. Request a new code.
id-import-match-unconfirmed: Please confirm that this record is yours.
id-password-weak: The password does not meet the requirements.
id-reclaim-forbidden: This account cannot be reclaimed. Contact Administration.
id-no-emis-link: Your account is not linked to EMIS.
id-emis-profile-mismatch: These EMIS credentials belong to a different EMIS account.
id-delete-forbidden: This account cannot be deleted here. Contact Administration.
id-mail-reclaimed-notice: Your account was reclaimed with EMIS credentials: the password was changed and all sessions, connectors and Telegram links were signed out. If this was not you, contact Administration.
id-mail-deleted-notice: Your account was deleted. Your personal data will be removed on {closes_on}; attendance and marks stay in the lyceum's records.
id-mail-deletion-scheduled: Your account is scheduled for deletion on {closes_on}. Changed your mind? Log in to IHT ID again before that date and choose Restore. Attendance and marks stay in the lyceum's records.
